verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs state that deposit and wallet accounts are held in FBO structures, and that they run on a native ledger. They also say teams can view account and transaction data through the Dashboard and APIs, which partly addresses the story's structure and ledger-visibility elements. The evidence never explains where FDIC insurance attaches, how pass-through coverage works across one or more partner banks, or any granular ledger access model. Missing for 10: plain documentation of FDIC insurance attachment and pass-through coverage, explanation of FBO pooled vs individual account distinctions, explicit ledger visibility/permissions documentation, independent corroboration.
